nodes.description: Initializer; deploys the RewardDistributionTokenUpgradeable implementation and wires the staking token provider.
Admin-only function that registers a staking pool for a vault and deploys its reward distribution token clone.
Permissionless loop that refreshes multiple pools.
Permissionless pool refresh; recomputes staking token from the provider and redeploys the dividend token if it changed.
Admin-only entry that pulls reward tokens from the caller and distributes them to the pool's dividend token.
External deposit entry; refreshes the pool and stakes msg.sender's tokens.
Deposit entry restricted to the zap contract; stakes on behalf of another account.
Claims rewards and withdraws the caller's full balance in one call.
Recovers funds from a pool identified only by token addresses; claims rewards then withdraws.
Recovers funds from an arbitrary token pair without claiming rewards first.
Withdraws a caller-specified amount from the vault pool.
Withdraws accrued reward dividends for the caller.
View of the staked balance held in the deterministic dividend token for a vault.
Internal deposit: pulls staking tokens via safeTransferFrom then mints dividend tokens.
Internal claim: calls withdrawReward on the pool dividend token.
Internal withdraw: burns dividend tokens then transfers staking tokens back.
Deploys a deterministic minimal-proxy clone of the dividend token and initializes it.
Derives the CREATE2 address of the pool's dividend token.
Guardian-only function that activates a pause lock id.
Owner-only function that clears a pause lock id.
Owner-only function that grants or revokes guardian status, which controls pausing.
Access gate that blocks non-owners while a lock id is paused.
Owner-only reward distribution; increases magnifiedRewardPerShare by amount*magnitude/totalSupply.
Owner-only payout of a user's accumulated rewards from the target ERC20.
Owner-only dividend-token mint entry point that forwards to the internal _mint.
Owner-only burn of a holder's dividend tokens.
Internal transfer that updates magnified reward corrections for both parties.
Internal mint that adjusts magnifiedRewardCorrections so dividends stay constant.
Internal burn that adjusts magnifiedRewardCorrections so dividends stay constant.
Resolves the staking token paired with a vault token using the configured exchange factory.
Builds the staking token name from paired symbol metadata.
Computes the deterministic Uniswap-style pair address from sorted tokens.
Sorts two token addresses into canonical order.
Reference to the NFTX vault factory used for vault lookup and fee distributor authorization.
Implementation address cloned for every pool's reward distribution token.
Provider resolving staking token addresses and names.
Mapping from vault id to its StakingPool (staking token, reward token).
Magnified cumulative reward per share; core arithmetic accumulator for dividends.
Per-account signed correction keeping dividends constant across balance changes.
Per-account record of rewards already paid out.
The ERC20 token whose dividends are distributed and transferred out.
Mapping of lock id to paused flag gating sensitive operations.
Mapping of addresses allowed to pause operations.
Exchange factory used for pair address derivation.
Per-vault-token override of the paired token.
Fallback paired token when no per-vault override exists.
Caller address; drives deposits, withdrawals, reward claims and all admin gating.
SafeERC20 safeTransferFrom performing an external token transferFrom into the pool.
SafeERC20 safeTransfer sending tokens out to a user or dividend token.
Low-level call with value used by SafeERC20 wrappers; forwards arbitrary gas to a target.
CREATE2 deployment of a minimal proxy clone at a deterministic address.
Vault identifier used to look up the StakingPool entry.
Token amount supplied to deposit/withdraw/distribute functions.
Account receiving or losing staked dividend tokens in internal helpers.
StakingPool memory struct loaded from vaultStakingInfo.
keccak256 salt of staking and reward tokens used for deterministic cloning.
Address of the cloned reward distribution token.
Holder address whose reward is withdrawn in withdrawReward.
Amount of dividend tokens transferred, minted or burned.
Transfer destination in the dividend token transfer paths.
Transfer origin in the dividend token transfer paths.
Computed withdrawable reward amount paid out in withdrawReward.
Implementation address used by the clone deployment helper.
Encoded calldata forwarded to the low-level call in SafeERC20/Address.
Staking token address recomputed from the provider during a pool update.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the staking account in deposit.
msg.sender is checked against the zap contract and used as the paying account.
msg.sender's balance is claimed and withdrawn in exit.
msg.sender is the withdrawer and staking account.
msg.sender is the reward payer and is used as the safeTransferFrom source.
msg.sender is emitted as the reward distributor in the RewardsDistributed event.
pause is gated by the isGuardian mapping keyed on msg.sender.
unpause is restricted to the contract owner via onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setIsGuardian grants pause rights and is owner-gated on msg.sender.
addPoolForVault is gated by the onlyAdmin modifier comparing msg.sender to owner/feeDistributor.
receiveRewards is gated by onlyAdmin on msg.sender.
withdrawReward is owner-gated, restricting who can trigger payout.
mint of dividend tokens is owner-gated.
burnFrom is owner-gated and can destroy arbitrary holder balances.
deposit refreshes the pool before staking.
deposit forwards to the internal deposit helper.
depositFor forwards to the internal deposit helper.
depositFor reads zapContract from the vault factory before allowing the deposit.
exit claims rewards before withdrawing.
exit withdraws the full staked balance.
emergencyExitAndClaim claims rewards for an arbitrary token pair.
emergencyExitAndClaim withdraws the full dividend-token balance.
emergencyExit withdraws without claiming rewards.
withdraw forwards to the internal withdraw helper.
claimRewards forwards to the internal claim helper.
addPoolForVault resolves the staking token through the provider.
addPoolForVault deploys the pool's dividend token.
addPoolForVault reads and writes vaultStakingInfo through the pool update path.
updatePoolForVault redeploys the dividend token when the staking token changes.
updatePoolForVault re-queries the provider for the current staking token.
_deployDividendToken uses cloneDeterministic CREATE2 deployment.
_deployDividendToken asks the provider for the staking token name.
_deposit pulls staking tokens with safeTransferFrom.
_deposit mints dividend tokens on the pool token clone.
_withdraw burns the caller's dividend tokens.
_withdraw returns the staking tokens with safeTransfer.
_claimRewards invokes withdrawReward on the dividend token.
withdrawReward pays the holder using safeTransfer on the target token.
receiveRewards pulls reward tokens with safeTransferFrom.
receiveRewards calls distributeRewards on the pool token.
mint forwards to the internal _mint.
burnFrom forwards to the internal _burn.
_transfer multiplies magnifiedRewardPerShare by the transferred value.
_mint multiplies magnifiedRewardPerShare by the minted value for the correction.
_burn multiplies magnifiedRewardPerShare by the burned value for the correction.
distributeRewards adds amount*magnitude/totalSupply into magnifiedRewardPerShare.
_transfer adds/subtracts signed corrections for both accounts.
_mint subtracts the minted-value correction from the account.
_burn adds the burned-value correction back to the account.
withdrawReward accumulates paid amounts in withdrawnRewards.
withdrawReward transfers the target token to the user.
stakingTokenForVaultToken computes the pair address via pairFor.
pairFor sorts the token addresses before hashing.
The initializer sets the dividend token implementation address.
The initializer sets the staking token provider.
addPoolForVault writes the StakingPool struct into vaultStakingInfo.
updatePoolForVault rewrites the StakingPool struct in vaultStakingInfo.
deposit reads the pool entry from vaultStakingInfo.
addPoolForVault resolves the vault address from the factory.
deposit indirectly refreshes pool data through the provider during updatePoolForVault.
_deposit uses the staking token resolved by the provider.
safeTransferFrom of an arbitrary pool token executes external code before the corresponding mint completes.
receiveRewards pulls tokens with safeTransferFrom before distributeRewards updates magnifiedRewardPerShare.
_withdraw burns dividend tokens then transfers the staking token, whose hooks can re-enter the staking contract.
target.safeTransfer in withdrawReward invokes an external token that may call back into reward accounting.
The amount parameter flows into the staking/burning helper.
vaultId selects which StakingPool is used in deposit.
The receiving account parameter is passed to the dividend-token mint.
The loaded StakingPool struct determines the token addresses used in _deposit.
The salt derived from pool tokens controls the deterministic clone address.
The deployed clone address is initialized and returned.
The user parameter determines whose rewards are computed and paid.
The value parameter drives the reward correction arithmetic in _transfer.
The recipient parameter receives the corrected balance in _transfer.
The sender parameter has its corrected balance reduced in _transfer.
The computed withdrawable reward gates and sizes the payout.
The implementation parameter is embedded into the clone bytecode.
Encoded calldata is forwarded to the low-level call.
The recomputed staking token is compared and stored during a pool update.

normalization_plan.reason: vaultId is only used to index vaultStakingInfo before the deposit core operation.
amount is the token quantity consumed by the staking transfer/mint core operation.
account is the beneficiary passed straight into the mint core operation.
The StakingPool struct only supplies token addresses to the deposit core operation.
salt is a transient input to the clone deployment core operation.
The returned clone address is the result of the deployment core operation.
user identifies the holder whose reward the payout core operation settles.
value scales the reward correction arithmetic inside the transfer core operation.
recipient is the destination of the transfer core operation.
sender is the origin of the transfer core operation.
The computed value directly gates and sizes the external payout.
implementation is injected into the CREATE2 clone bytecode.
data is the raw calldata forwarded to the low-level external call.
The recomputed token drives the pool rewrite and possible redeployment.
